recipe.title: Rhubarb and orange compote with yoghurt
steps: Grate the zest of one orange into a medium saucepan and squeeze in its juice. Cut the peel and pith from the second orange, slice into rounds, then quarter each round.
Add the rhubarb, honey and ginger to the pan. Cover and cook over a medium to low heat for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring gently once, until the rhubarb is soft but still holding its shape.
Meanwhile, toast the hazelnuts in a dry frying pan for 3 to 4 minutes, shaking the pan, until golden. Roughly chop.
Take the compote off the heat, fold in the orange pieces and leave to cool for a few minutes.
Spoon the yoghurt into bowls, top with the warm compote and scatter over the hazelnuts.
